name: Undead Patron

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A pact with a lich, vampire or other deathless power that lends its dread form and its mastery over the boundary of death.

feature.name: Form of Dread
feature.summary: Bonus Action: transform for 1 minute (1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points, immune to Frightened, a hit can frighten once per turn). Charisma-modifier uses per Long Rest.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you become an avatar of your patron's dread for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you end it (no action). You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a Long Rest. Facsimile of Life: you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Warlock level. Frightful Avatar: you have Immunity to the Frightened condition, and once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

feature.name: Undead Spells
feature.summary: Blindness/Deafness, False Life, Phantasmal Force and Ray of Sickness always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: When you reach a Warlock level shown, you always have these spells prepared: Blindness/Deafness, False Life, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness (3); Speak with Dead, Vampiric Touch (5); Death Ward, Phantasmal Killer (7); Antilife Shell, Cloudkill (9).

feature.name: Grave Touched
feature.summary: Your Necrotic damage ignores Resistance; in Form of Dread, once per turn a damaging spell can deal Necrotic instead; no need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep.
feature.text: Arcane Necrosis: Necrotic damage you deal with spells and attack rolls ignores Resistance to Necrotic damage, and once per turn while in your Form of Dread you can change a damaging spell's damage type to Necrotic. Undead Endurance: you don't gain Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation, you don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep.

feature.name: Necrotic Husk
feature.summary: Resistance to Necrotic (Immunity in Form of Dread); once per Short Rest, dropping to 0 erupts in a 30-foot Necrotic blast and leaves you at 10 × Charisma modifier Hit Points.
feature.text: Necrotic Resilience: you have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and Immunity to it while in your Form of Dread. Unholy Resuscitation: if you drop to 0 Hit Points and don't die outright, your body can erupt: each creature of your choice within 30 feet makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d10 plus your Warlock level Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Your Hit Points then become 10 times your Charisma modifier (minimum 10) and you gain 1 Exhaustion level. Once used, not again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feature.name: Superior Dread
feature.summary: In Form of Dread: fly at your Speed and hover, no components for Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells, and regain Charisma-modifier Hit Points when you deal Necrotic damage.
feature.text: While in your Form of Dread: Flight: a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you can hover. Profane Casting: your Warlock spells of the Conjuration and Necromancy schools need no Verbal, Somatic or Material components, except Material components that are consumed or have a cost. Vitality Siphon: once per turn when you deal Necrotic damage to a creature, you regain Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
